docs.title: Document
docs.summary: Multi-section technical specs, PRDs, and RFCs (structure/*.md) with real-time collaboration and review suggestions

outline.title: Outline
outline.summary: Infinitely nested tree outline (structure/outline.json) with folding, branch zoom, checkable tasks, and live co-editing

slides.title: Slide Deck
slides.summary: 16:9 or 4:3 structured presentation deck (deck.json + slides/*.json) with progressive fragments, presenter view, and PDF export

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.summary: Structured datasets separated from KPI and chart panels (dashboard.json + data/*.json) with field-level provenance and CSV export

motion.title: Motion Film
motion.summary: Deterministic pure-time motion graphics (timeline.json + scenes/*.json) with frame scrubbing, chapters, and video export

whiteboard.title: Whiteboard
whiteboard.summary: Infinite spatial canvas (structure/board.json) with cards, containers, connectors, timelines, and built-in editorial stickers

design.title: Design Canvas
design.summary: Multi-artboard UI and visual mockups (structure/frames/*.json) with design-system token linking and live property levers

design-system.title: Design System
design-system.summary: Light/dark design tokens and component specifications (tokens.json + components/*.json) reusable across visual artifacts

sheet.title: Spreadsheet
sheet.summary: Structured multi-sheet workbooks and datasets (workbook.json + sheets/*.json + asset/*.csv) with formulas, validation, and live collaboration

prototype.title: Web Prototype
prototype.summary: Runnable sandboxed HTML/CSS/JS interactive web prototype (index.html, styles.css, app.js) with live state and collaboration

diagram.title: Diagram
diagram.summary: Engineering diagrams for architecture, sequence, ER, and state machines (structure/diagram.json / .mmd) with collaborative editing

storyboard.title: Storyboard
storyboard.summary: Shot-by-shot visual, dialogue, and audio production script (shots.json + asset/{frames,refs,audio}/) bridging media generation and motion
